info.title: ClosetSearch HTTP API
info.description: Contract for the HTTP routes implemented by apps/api/src/app.ts and its domain route modules. All responses include X-Request-ID. JSON request bodies are limited to 64 KiB by default (configurable with HTTP_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES). Browser requests using PUT, POST, PATCH, or DELETE must pass the configured same-origin CSRF check. Cookie-authenticated routes derive identity exclusively from the session cookie; request bodies and legacy URL suffixes never select the acting user. Account-security, notification, listing-history, and durable alert-inbox routes require PostgreSQL. Billing webhooks and direct delivery-attempt APIs are intentionally absent because they are not wired to HTTP routes in the current implementation.

get.summary: Fetch a deterministically paginated discovery feed
get.description: Authentication is optional. A valid session enables personalization; signed-out callers receive the non-personalized feed.
At least one query or supported filter must be present. Comma-separated parameters are normalized by the API.

cookieAuth.name: closetsearch_session
cookieAuth.description: Opaque, HttpOnly session cookie. The cookie name is configurable with AUTH_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME; production cookies are Secure by default.

operationsBearer.description: Operations-only bearer token configured with OPERATIONS_BEARER_TOKEN.

RequestId.description: Opaque request correlation identifier generated by the API.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds before retrying a rate-limited request.

SetCookie.description: Creates or clears the opaque session cookie.

ResendWebhookId.name: svix-id
ResendWebhookId.description: Opaque provider event identifier covered by the webhook signature.

ResendWebhookTimestamp.name: svix-timestamp
ResendWebhookTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp covered by the webhook signature.

ResendWebhookSignature.name: svix-signature
ResendWebhookSignature.description: Versioned signature generated by the configured email provider.

TwilioWebhookSignature.name: X-Twilio-Signature
TwilioWebhookSignature.description: Twilio request signature calculated over the public callback URL and form fields.

AccountDelete.description: The acting user ID is always session-derived.

WatchlistInput.description: At least one of queryText, brand, category, source, listingType, min/max price, size, or condition must be present when creating.

EmailUnsubscribeToken.description: Opaque destination-bound token. It is never returned by this endpoint.

enum: Submit a POST request to confirm email unsubscription.

EmailWebhookEvent.description: The email provider may add fields; ClosetSearch only consumes the documented event type, recipient, and failure reason fields.

SmsWebhookEvent.description: Twilio may include additional signed form fields.

listingId.description: Normalized provider:source-listing-id public ID. Required for listing event types.

properties.description: Bounded metadata. Direct identifiers and secret-like keys are rejected.

DevelopmentEntitlementGrant.description: Actor identity cannot be supplied in the body.

AlertAction.description: User identity is derived from the authenticated session.

FeedOk.description: Feed response. Provider partial failures remain visible in `providers`.

SearchOk.description: Search response. Provider partial failures remain visible in `providers`.

EventAccepted.description: Event accepted, including an idempotent duplicate.

Analytics.description: Locked entitlement response or an observed-data analytics payload.

NotificationPreferences.description: Current notification preferences and delivery readiness.

NotificationReadiness.description: Current destination, consent, suppression, and transport readiness. The response uses Cache-Control: no-store.

PhoneIdentityCreated.description: Phone identity stored with explicit SMS consent. Verification is still required and the response uses Cache-Control: no-store.

PhoneIdentityRemoved.description: Phone identity removed and SMS delivery disabled. The response uses Cache-Control: no-store.

PhoneVerificationRequested.description: Phone verification request accepted without returning the code or provider details. The response uses Cache-Control: no-store.

PhoneVerified.description: Phone identity verified. The response uses Cache-Control: no-store.

WatchlistAlertSettings.description: User-owned watchlist alert policy. The response uses Cache-Control: no-store.

ListingDetail.description: Normalized durable listing detail with typed source, pricing, lifecycle, seller, shipping, and auction evidence.

ListingPriceTrend.description: Eligible typed price evidence, state, series, counts, filters, and robust summary statistics.

EmailUnsubscribeConfirmation.description: Token is valid and a POST confirmation is required. GET never mutates subscription state and the response uses Cache-Control: no-store.

EmailUnsubscribed.description: Email destination unsubscribed without echoing the destination or token. The response uses Cache-Control: no-store.

EmailWebhookAccepted.description: Signed email webhook accepted. Duplicate delivery is acknowledged without replaying side effects.

SmsWebhookAcknowledgement.description: TwiML acknowledgement or standards-compliant keyword response. No provider or delivery internals are returned.

AlertMatches.description: Compatibility alert-match envelope. Delivery state depends on the active persistence driver.

ObjectAccepted.description: Request accepted for asynchronous or externally delivered completion.

SensitiveObjectOk.description: Successful sensitive JSON response with Cache-Control: no-store.

SessionClearingObjectOk.description: Successful JSON response that clears the session cookie and uses Cache-Control: no-store.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, invalid body, invalid query, or CSRF-safe request validation failure.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or expired session.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden by CSRF, authorization, environment, or feature configuration.

Conflict.description: Resource conflicts with an existing record.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the configured limit.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Required persistence or service dependency is unavailable.

BadGateway.description: All configured providers failed the request.
